balls.text: very full delivery slanted into the pads. Shankar is cramped for room and is also nutmegged as the ball trickles off the pads towards the keeper. Just a leg bye!

three sixes in a row! Half-tracker outside off stump and that is just poor from Shardul! Shankar does not mind, though, and wallops it over wide long on! That just cleared the fence but it still counts as six in the scorecard!
six more! In the arc, and it goes out of the park! Shankar sits back in his crease again and batters it over the long on fence!
right out of the screws! Dug into the track outside off stump. Shankar stands tall and absolutely leathers it over deep mid wicket for six! That brings up his half-century too, off just 21 balls!
oh, well! Slower bumper outside off stump. Shankar looks to upper cut it over short third man but somehow manages to toe-end it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery on leg stump that rushes onto Miller. He can't free his arms and tugs it towards deep square leg for just a single
shot! In the slot outside off stump. Shankar sits back in his crease, swings through the line and sends it soaring over the long off fence!
slower delivery on a length on middle and leg stump. Miller plays too early as the ball trickles off the thigh pad into the off side
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Shankar opens up his stance and drags it towards long on for one
Shankar is on a roll! Full and wide outside off stump. Shankar throws his hands at it and flays it over short third man for another boundary!
top edged, and it flies for six! Back of a length delivery at the stumps. Shankar continues swiping and gets a massive top edge that clears the fence over the keeper's head!
back of a length delivery on off stump that sticks in the surface. Shankar has a slog at it and skies it. The keeper takes it but because of the hang-time, the batters get back for a brace
four more! Dug into the track at the stumps. Shankar clears his front leg and muscles it past deep mid wicket for four! Oh, hang on...looks like Ferguson has overstepped too!
length delivery outside off stump. Shankar opens up his stance and drills it down the ground towards long off
gets it away! Length delivery on middle and leg stump. Shankar has a swing at it and tickles it past the fielder at short fine leg for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Miller drops it into the leg side and saunters across to the other end

and Sudharsan perishes in that pursuit! Back of a length delivery outside off stump that hurries onto Sudharsan. He comes down the track and looks to clear long off but does not get the power or the elevation. Arrows it straight to Anukul at long off, who makes no mistake!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Shankar goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket for just a single
length delivery on middle and off stump. Sudharsan clears his front leg and mows it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on off stump. Sudharsan hangs back in his crease and flicks it uppishly towards deep square leg
full toss outside off stump. Shankar is late on the stroke and can only jab it towards extra cover for one
back of a length delivery on off stump. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and turns it towards deep mid wicket for a single
full delivery on off stump. Shankar sits deep in his crease and punches it on the bounce to long on
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Sudharsan gets inside the line and helps it round the corner towards fine leg. Gets to fifty too, his second successive half-century this season!
short and wide outside off stump. Sudharsan jumps up onto his toes and cuts it towards deep point. Russell runs around to his left and pulls it back into play
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Sudharsan rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid wicket for another single
fuller outside off stump. Shankar plants his front foot and drags it towards deep mid wicket for one
short delivery outside off stump again. Shankar heaves it away towards deep mid wicket for a couple of runs
shot! Dragged down outside off stump. Shankar picks the length early, stands tall and smacks it back past the bowler for four!
googly on a back of a length on middle and off stump. Shankar waits in his crease and works it towards deep backward square leg for a brace
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Shankar goes back and tucks it into the leg side. He places it so beautifully that he can gallop back for the second
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Shankar has a stab at it and seems to miss as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the off side
full delivery just outside off stump. Sudharsan comes onto the front foot and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Sudharsan stays leg side of the ball and runs it down to third man. He then senses an opportunity for the second and hares back
dug into the track on middle and off stump. Sudharsan gauges the line and the length early and sways out of the way comfortably
shot! Banged into the track outside off stump. Sudharsan gets on top of the bounce and disdainfully dispatches it over mid wicket for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Shankar looks to work to leg but plays all around it as the ball pops up off the thigh pad into the on side
length delivery just outside off stump. Sudharsan goes back and nurdles it into the vast open spaces on the leg side for a sharp brace
googly on a length outside off stump. Sudharsan throws his hands at it and slices it past backward point for a couple of runs

full delivery outside off stump. Shankar gets a massive stride outside the line and while he misses, the ball pings off the pads into the off side for a leg bye. oh dear! Suyash has somehow convinced his skipper to review this. Pretty sure this struck him well outside off! Replays show that the ball got sandwiched between the bat and the pad, with the third umpire concluding that it definitively hit the bat first. Shankar survives!

what a ripper! Googly on a length on off stump. Manohar does not quite pick it and goes searching for it. He leaves a gap between bat and pad, and then sees the ball rip through that gap. It kisses the outside of the front pad before smashing into the stumps! Suyash is over the moon, and why should he not be!

length delivery outside off stump. Sudharsan hangs back in his crease and cuts it towards deep point. The batters initially settle for two before the fielder fires a direct hit at the batter's end and concedes an overthrow off the deflection
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Sudharsan goes back and dabs it towards short third man
full delivery on leg stump. Sudharsan gets forward and works it towards deep mid wicket for one more run
edged! Full delivery outside off stump. Manohar throws the kitchen sink at it and gets a thick outside edge that Gurbaz can only get his right glove to
slower delivery on a full length just outside off stump. Manohar stabs it towards extra cover
three fours in a row! In the slot outside off stump and Manohar does not miss out! He plants his front foot and chips it over mid off!
four more! Slower delivery dug into the track on leg stump. Manohar gets inside the line of the ball and helps it over short fine leg
Short, wide and punished! Too much width and Manohar throws his hands at it, slashing it over backward point for a boundary!
fuller just outside off stump. Manohar goes feeling for it and chunks it off the inside edge into the leg side for a single
length delivery just outside off stump. Manohar comes forward and defends into the off side

holes out to long on! Length delivery hung outside off stump, and it forces Gill to fetch it. He advances and tries to go over long on but because he has to reach out for it, he ends up chalking it. Umesh settles himself under the high ball at long on, and does the rest!
length delivery just outside off stump. Gill nudges it into the vast real estate on the leg side and scampers across for a brace
length delivery on middle and off stump. Sudharsan goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
six more! Full delivery just outside off stump. Sudharsan plants his front foot and pumps it over the fielder at long on!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that cramps Sudharsan up for room. He stabs at it anyway and collects a single to backward point
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. Gill reaches out for it and pushes it towards deep cover point
full delivery outside off stump. Gill gets a half stride forward and scuffs it down the ground towards mid off
off-pace delivery on a full length on middle and off stump. Sudharsan comes forward and flicks it towards long on for one
back of a length delivery outside off stump that zips through. Sudharsan throws his hands at it but is late on the stroke
slower delivery that just slides down the leg side. Sudharsan does not get bat on it but the ball flicks the pad on its way through to the keeper
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Sudharsan goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point for one
length delivery just outside off stump. Gill takes a step down the track and knocks it towards long off
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Sudharsan presses half forward and turns it towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery on off stump. Gill hangs back and short-arm jabs it towards deep mid wicket for a single

very full delivery down the leg side. Gill looks to paddle it fine but seems to miss it altogether. Gurbaz thinks it has grazed the bat on its way through but the umpire is having none of it. Called a wide!
four more! Full delivery outside off stump. Gill marches down the track and smashes it over the bowler's head!
slider on a length just outside off stump. Gill goes back and dabs it towards backward point
into the slot, and into the stands! Gives Sudharsan just enough room outside off stump and he swings through the line, launching this well over the long on fence!
length delivery angled into leg stump. Gill uses the angle and tucks it away towards deep square leg
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Sudharsan comes forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for one more run
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Gill comes down the track and for a change, hoicks it in ugly fashion towards deep backward square leg
length delivery on middle and off stump. Sudharsan presses half forward and works it towards deep mid wicket
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Gill presses forward and eases it towards deep mid wicket
googly on a length outside off stump again. Sudharsan has another waft at it and connects with fresh air for the second consecutive ball
wrong'un on a length outside off stump. Sudharsan does not quite pick it until very late and stabs at it, only to get beaten on the outside
dispatched! In the slot on middle and off stump. Sudharsan plants his front foot and bangs it over the bowler's head for a boundary!
full delivery just outside off stump. Gill gets forward and flicks it down the ground towards long on for a single
another googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Gill dabs it towards backward point
googly on a back of a length outside off stump. Sudharsan goes back and punches it towards deep cover point for a single
shot! Given a bit of air just outside off stump. Gill comes out his bunker again and lofts it nonchalantly over extra cover for four!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Sudharsan hangs back and cuts it towards deep point for one more run
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Gill gets inside the line of the ball and glances it towards short fine leg for one
length delivery on middle and off stump. Gill takes a step down the track and pats it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery on off stump. Sudharsan rocks back and hacks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
full delivery on middle and off stump. Gill comes forward and turns it into the leg side for one
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gill tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket and collects another single
two in a row! Full and outside off stump. Gill leans into the drive and caresses it between extra cover and mid off!
lovely! Full delivery just outside off stump. Gill dances down the track, opens his bat face just a shade and cracks it past mid off for four!
length delivery fired down the leg side. Gill does not make contact and the keeper can't come around to gather either. Five extras added to Gujarat's total!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gill goes back and jabs it into the off side
oh, nearly! Length delivery just outside off stump. Sudharsan bunts it into the off side and sets off for the single. Had the fielder hit the stumps, Sudharsan would have been on his way!
length delivery on leg stump. Gill lets the ball come to him before helping it behind square on the leg side for a single
full delivery just outside off stump. Sudharsan comes onto the front foot and taps it into the off side
clever from Sudharsan! Slightly quicker and flatter on a back of a length outside off stump. Sudharsan uses the pace and glides it past short third man
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Sudharsan goes back and stabs it towards extra cover
fuller and outside off stump. Sudharsan comes forward and defends it into the off side
length delivery darted down the leg side. Sudharsan does not get bat on it as the umpire calls it a wide

taken this time, brilliantly by Jagadeesan! Full delivery at the stumps and Saha looks to sweep it away. He gets down on one knee but the ball seems to stick in the surface ever so slightly. The ball skews off the top edge and lobs up towards mid wicket, where Jagadeesan runs backwards and completes a superb take!
safe! Tossed up on a full length just outside off stump. Saha reaches out for it and just manages to slice it over cover point
length delivery just outside off stump. Gill presses half forward and pokes it back to the bowler
length delivery angled into leg stump. Saha gets into a bit of a tangle and is also cramped for room. He wafts but misses as the ball deflects off the thigh pad for a leg bye
slower delivery that goes awry and slides well down the leg side. Some more exercise for the umpire
length delivery just outside off stump. Saha comes half forward and punches it towards cover. 151.4 clicks that!
what a shot! Full and outside off stump. Saha plants his front foot, gets his hands through the ball and crashes it over extra cover for four. That was bowled at 150.5 kph!
very full delivery outside off stump. Gill opens the bat face and guides it towards deep point for a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Gill is squared up a touch as he defends towards backward point
back of a length delivery on off stump. Saha misses his pull again and this time, cops a blow in the midriff for his troubles
shot! In the slot outside off stump and Saha cashes in! He plants his front foot and lifts it effortlessly over mid off for four!
length delivery hung way outside off stump. Saha wafts and misses but then sees the umpire indulge in a bit of exercise
slower delivery dug into the track just outside off stump. Saha is early on the pull and ends up dragging it towards short fine leg
slower delivery on a length just outside off stump. Saha dangles his bat and gets a thick inside edge that thuds into his thigh pad. A bit of grip on that off-pace delivery!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Gill gets up on his toes and works it towards mid wicket for another run
very full delivery on middle and off stump. Saha tips it down the ground and saunters across to the other end
shot! Full delivery just outside off stump, and Gill pounces! He springs forward and delightfully clips it between mid on and mid wicket for four!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Saha plants his front foot and swings it away towards fine leg for one
on a length and fired down the leg side. Saha does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
full delivery on leg stump. Gill comes onto the front foot and helps it behind square on the leg side for one more run
oh! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump that decks back sharply. Saha has a waft at it and is cut in half. Gurbaz can't collect cleanly, though, and concedes a bye
streaky! Dug into the track on off stump. Saha shapes for the pull but is late on the stroke as the ball flicks the helmet and flies over the keeper's head
length delivery slanted into leg stump. Gill uses the pace and glances it down to fine leg for a single
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gill lets the ball come to him before tucking it off his hips towards deep square leg
full and angled into leg stump. Saha does not make contact with his flick as the ball trickles off the pads into the on side for a leg bye
back of a length delivery on leg stump that hurries onto Saha. He looks for the pull but is late on the stroke as the ball pings into his body
back of a length delivery outside off stump that just holds up in the surface a little. Gill goes back and punches it into the off side for one
full delivery just outside off stump. Saha gets a half stride forward and flicks it towards mid on to get off the mark
full delivery just outside off stump that shapes away a touch. Saha comes forward and defends it with a dead bat

KKR WIN! I HAVE NEVER SEEN ANYTHING QUITE LIKE THIS IN THE IPL! Short, and outside off stump and Rinku absolutely climbs into it! His eyes light up and he pummels it over the long on fence to seal a miraculous three-wicket victory for KKR! Just let that sink it, Rinku has hit five sixes in a row to send KKR and their fans into absolute delirium!
six more! Oh my word! Would you believe it?! Half-tracker outside off stump. Rinku opens up his stance and clatters it over long on! This is simply unbelievable!
three sixes in a row! Game on! Another poor and wayward full toss well outside off stump. Rinku uses the width on offer and clobbers it over long off!
oh, hello! Oh, hello! Low full toss down the leg side. Rinku gets inside the line very early and shovels it over the deep backward square leg fence!
first six ticked off the list! Full toss outside off stump. Rinku throws his hands at it and creams it over wide long off for another maximum!
slower delivery at the batter on off stump. Umesh is almost a week early into his stroke and clogs it towards long on for just a single
four more! Back of a length delivery angled into middle and leg stump. Rinku manufactures swinging room for himself and drags it past deep mid wicket!
clears the fence but is it too little, too late?! Slower delivery that lands right in the slot outside off stump. Rinku takes a step down the track and pounds it into the sightscreen!
slower delivery on a full length on leg stump. Rinku swings it away but can't beat the fielder at deep backward square leg
excellent yorker outside off stump. Rinku throws his hands at it but can only chalk it back to the bowler
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. Umesh swings like a rusty gate and misses the ball by a mile. Rinku, though, is alert enough to sneak in a bye
short and wide outside off stump. Rinku fetches it and pulls it down the ground for just another run
another wild back of a length delivery sprayed outside off stump. Rinku lets it go as the umpire indulges in some more exercise
back of a length delivery way outside off stump. Left alone by Rinku and called a wide by the umpire
full toss on middle and leg stump. Rinku is again late on the stroke and clogs it towards deep mid wicket for just another single
yorker on leg stump. Umesh jams his bat down in time and digs it out into the leg side for one more run
low full toss just outside off stump. Rinku crouches down low and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. Excellent work by Shankar to keep it down to one!
short delivery outside off stump. Umesh clears his front leg and flat-bats it down the ground for a single
full delivery outside off stump. Rinku has a massive mow at it but only manages to squirt it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
low full toss just outside off stump. Rinku comes half forward and drives it towards extra cover
full delivery on leg stump. Rinku works it behind square on the leg side and retains strike
length delivery on middle and off stump. Umesh winds up and heaves it towards deep mid wicket for a single
googly on a length on middle and leg stump. Umesh lunges forward and pokes at it, only to get beaten on the inside and to get rapped on the back leg

hat-trick for Rashid! Oh my word! This is incredible! Googly on a length on middle and off stump. Just like the other day, Shardul does not pick the googly. Against RCB, he got an inside edge that saved him but today, he does not get any bat as the ball smashes into the pads, right in front of middle and off stump. The umpire raises his finger but Shardul wants to have another look! No bat involved, and three reds on Ball Tracking! Rashid has an IPL hat-trick, and GT inch closer to yet another victory!

one brings two! Rashid has turned this game on its head! Length delivery on middle and off stump. Narine, sticking to his brief of attacking Rashid, has a mow across the line. He gets a good piece of it but it is not good enough to clear deep mid wicket. The fielder comfortably pouches it, a few yards inside the rope!

googly on a back of a length on leg stump. Russell has a massive heave at it and seems to miss as the ball pops up off the thigh pad and nestles into the keeper's gloves. Bharat, though, is convinced there is some bat involved and GT, in fact, review! Oh, hello! Looks like there is plenty of merit in that review. Russell has absolutely smashed that off the inside edge into his pad. And Rashid gets the better of Russell, just when his team needed him to!
low full toss outside off stump. Russell comes forward tentatively and pushes it towards extra cover for a single

holes out to long on! Joseph breaks open the game again! Full and aimed at the batter's toes. It is not the yorker Joseph was looking for but it cramps Iyer for room just enough. He has a swing at it but can't generate the power or the elevation, hitting it straight down Gill's throat!

oh dear! Full delivery outside off stump. Iyer sits deep in his crease and chips it over mid off. Rashid runs back from extra cover and pulls it back in, only for the ball to ping into Miller's leg and roll away into the fence!
safe! Full toss just outside leg stump. Iyer is surprised by the length and mistimes it. Luckily for him, he shanks it so badly that it does not even carry to mid off
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rinku can't get hold of it and clogs it towards deep mid wicket for a single

full delivery just outside leg stump. Rinku shuffles across and misses his attempted scoop. The umpire does not call it a wide because Rinku has moved so far across. KKR, though, want to have another look! The third umpire reasons that the batter has shuffled across and upholds the original call!
what a shot! In the slot on middle and leg stump again. Iyer gives himself a bit of room, swings through the line and crunches it over long off!
short and this one is darted down the leg side. Iyer gets inside the line of the ball and heaves it over short fine leg. The ball bounces thrice and trickles into the ropes!
length delivery angled into the batter. Iyer shimmies across his stumps and looks for the lap shot but makes no contact at all
shot! In the slot outside off stump. Iyer plants his front foot and bludgeons it towards mid off. The fielder gets a hand to it but can't prevent the boundary!
full and fired down the leg side. Iyer does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
full delivery just outside off stump. Rinku comes half forward and pushes it back to the bowler, who gets a hand to it
full and darted into leg stump. Iyer tucks it off his toes and collects a single to deep mid wicket
full delivery at the pads. Iyer brings his wrists into play and flicks it away towards deep mid wicket. Just a single, though
full delivery slanted across the batter outside off stump. Iyer throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep cover point for a brace
back of a length delivery on leg stump that hurries onto Rinku. He is late on the pull again and gloves it down to fine leg to get off the mark
sharp bumper on leg stump. Rinku comes down the track and hacks at it, getting nowhere close to the ball in the end
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rinku lets the ball come to him before tapping it towards mid wicket

and he sends Rana packing! Full delivery on middle and off stump. Rana plants his front foot and looks to go over mid off but does not display enough conviction. He has a half-hearted push at it and ends up chipping it straight to Shami at mid off!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Iyer goes back and slices it past backward point for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rana goes back and works it towards deep backward square leg for one
length delivery on middle and off stump. Rana has a swipe at this one too but for a change, does not get much bat on it
another boundary! Length delivery on leg stump. Rana shuffles across and manages to tickle it past the keeper!
shot! Full delivery on off stump. Rana brings out the switch hit and nails it over short third man!
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Iyer gets onto the back foot and knocks it down the ground for a single
into the stands again! Slot ball on middle and off stump, and it gets met! Rana has a clean swing through the line and clubs it over long on!
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Rana does not pick the variation and this time, swishes early. Another play and miss!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that skids through. Rana looks to slash it away but is late on the stroke and is beaten for pace
short and wide outside off stump. Iyer gets up on his toes and cuts it fiercely towards deep cover point
big shot! Half-tracker at the stumps and Iyer takes full toll! He waits in his crease and whacks it over deep square leg for a maximum!
full delivery that drifts onto the pads. Iyer uses the angle and glances it past fine leg for a boundary! Gets to fifty too!
picks the gap! Dragged down on middle and leg stump. Rana has all the time in the world to get into position and smash it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg!
short delivery on leg stump. Iyer rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid wicket for one more run
clean as a whistle! Fired into the slot on middle and off stump. Iyer gets down on one knee and smokes it well over the deep mid wicket fence!
darted into the stumps. Rana turns it into the leg side and is content with just a single
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that skids through. Rana has a swish at it but misses
full delivery on leg stump. Iyer comes forward and works it towards deep square leg
yorker on leg stump. Iyer uses the pace and tucks it off his toes towards deep square leg
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Rana goes back and cuts it towards deep cover point for one
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Rana goes fishing at it but makes no contact whatsoever
short delivery outside off stump. Iyer pulls it away towards deep mid wicket and collects a single
four more! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Iyer skips down the track and batters it past long on for another boundary!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Rana goes back and taps it into the off side
full delivery on leg stump. Rana gets a big stride forward and helps it round the corner for one more run
full delivery on middle and off stump. Rana gets across his stumps, gets down on one knee and paddles it past short fine leg for four!
googly that is dropped short on leg stump. Iyer waits in his crease and swings it away towards deep mid wicket
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Rana lunges forward and turns it behind square on the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Iyer hops back and pulls it away towards deep mid wicket for one
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Iyer goes deep into his crease and cuts it towards deep cover point for a couple of runs
Has that gone all the way? Yes, it has! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rana gives himself just enough room and carves it over third man for six!
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rana presses half forward and defends it back to the bowler
length delivery on leg stump. Rana looks to help it behind square but is again late on his stroke as the ball thuds into the thigh pad
high and handsome! Dug into the track on middle and leg stump, and this time, Rana is waiting for it. This one also sits up nicely for Rana and he deposits it over the deep square leg fence!
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that skips through. Rana is late on the stroke and sees the ball whistle past the bat
length delivery just outside off stump. Rana comes half forward and prods it back to the bowler
short delivery outside off stump. Rana waits in his crease and drags it towards deep square leg for a single
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Rana gets behind the line of the ball and pats it gently towards mid wicket
length delivery on middle and off stump. Iyer comes half forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
six more! Short on leg stump. Iyer is a little late on the stroke but does brilliantly to get inside the line and help it over the fine leg fence!
shot! Fractionally short on middle and off stump. Iyer picks up the length early and dumps it over mid wicket for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rana goes back and turns it into the on side towards deep square leg
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Iyer shimmies around his crease before punching it straight to the fielder at cover point
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Rana looks to work to leg but does not get bat on it as the ball pings off the thigh pad into the on side
length delivery on middle and off stump. Iyer comes half forward and punches it crisply past extra cover for a single
length delivery on leg stump. Iyer flicks it straight to the fielder in the ring at mid wicket
shot! At the stumps but Iyer has a riposte for it. He gets into position very early and helps it over short fine leg for four!
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Iyer gets up on his toes and drops it into the off side
dug into the track on middle and leg stump. Rana gets onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Iyer pokes it down the ground and canters across to the other end
shot! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Iyer stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and cracks it past extra cover for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Rana goes back and tugs it into the leg side to get off the mark
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Iyer opens his bat face and runs it down to third man for a single
back of a length delivery on off stump. Iyer gets up on his toes and stabs it down the ground towards mid on

holes out to deep square leg! Length delivery on middle and leg stump. Jagadeesan plants his front foot and gets decent contact on his flick. But he does not go through with his shot and ends up arrowing it straight down Manohar's throat at deep square leg!
length delivery hung well outside off stump. Jagadeesan advances and wafts at it, only connecting with fresh air
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Jagadeesan waits in his crease and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Jagadeesan laces his cut but can't beat Tewatia at backward point

back of a length delivery on off stump. Iyer comes down the track and powers it towards mid on. The fielder misfields, and Iyer decides to run on it. Would have been out had the fielder hit the stumps
full delivery just outside off stump. Jagadeesan tips it down the ground and scampers across to the other end. Makes it comfortably, despite the direct hit
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Iyer presses half forward and defends it towards backward point
what a way to get off the mark! Short, wide and Iyer climbs into it! He jumps up onto his toes, throws his hands at it and scythes it over the third man fence!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Iyer gets up on his toes and jabs it towards cover point

gloves it, and taken by Dayal! Back of a length delivery on leg stump that hurries onto Gurbaz. He has a swipe at it but is late on the stroke, meaning that he eventually gloves it. Bharat and Dayal go for the catch and run into each other, but the latter, somehow, manages to cling on diving forward! The communication system broke down there but Dayal did well to keep his eyes on the prize!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz takes a step across his stumps and slashes it down to third man for a couple of runs
fractionally short just outside off stump. Gurbaz transfers his weight onto the back foot and muscles it over mid wicket for four!
length delivery just outside off stump. Gurbaz walks across his stumps and hoicks it towards deep square leg for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz gets onto the back foot and defends it towards backward point
shot! Full delivery just outside off stump. Gurbaz marches down the track and blasts it over the bowler's head and into the sightscreen!
length delivery just outside off stump. Jagadeesan has a nibble at it and gets a thick outside edge that dribbles down to third man
off the mark in style! Short and wide outside off stump again. This time, Jagadeesan hops up onto his toes and threads it past backward point for four!
back of a length delivery angled across the batter outside off stump. Jagadeesan throws his hands at it but makes no contact whatsoever
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Gurbaz thinks about playing at it initially before bailing out of the stroke at the last moment
back of a length delivery on off stump, Gurbaz has a stab at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg for a couple of runs
back of a length delivery in the fifth stump channel outside off stump. Gurbaz has a long, hard look at it before letting it go
back of a length delivery outside off stump that zips through. Gurbaz has a waft at it and is beaten for pace
oh! Back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gurbaz advances and has a mow across the line. Gets nowhere close to the ball, though
back of a length delivery outside off stump that shapes away a touch. Gurbaz goes back and lets it go through to the keeper
